strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Aestivalis or Nadesico destroyed
Hmm... This is troubling. And on the Nadesico's maiden voyage, too.
Yurika, what do we do?
Hmmm. Okay! We'll go through the undersea gate into the water,
then surface and wipe out the enemy from behind.
Well then, shall we see what you all can do?
But the engine's still cold! An emergency launch is a no-go!
What do we do?
That's where I come in!
My robot heads up to the surface and draws the enemy in as a decoy.
Meanwhile, the Nadesico launches! Oooh, what a fiery situation!
...Idiot.
Come and get it!
That was fast! Hey, Yamada!
It's Dai-go-ji... Gai! I told you, leave it to me!
Come on, bring it!
Well, well... I suppose we'll wait and see...
Minato!
Okaaay, five more... no, about four minutes.
If that's all...
...I have a feeling this definitely won't work, though.
Hold it right there, you! That Aestivalis is...!
Uribatake?
All riiight. Keep 'em coming! I'll smash you to bits with my Gekigan Punch!
Wow, wow! Yamada's all fired up! He might actually pull this off!?
He's one of our few combat staff... He should do at least this much.
Hey! Yamada! Don't go any farther out than that!
Intercept everything from there! Got it!?
What's with him all this time...?
I told you to call me Gai! Raaah, take this!
Um, Yamada.
I keep tellin' you, it's Gai! Gai Daigoji!
...Yamada's unit is leaving the Nadesico's energy supply range.
What the...? My Gekiganger suddenly stopped moving!?
Hey, Uribatakeee!
Aw, jeez... You idiot! That Aestivalis you're riding
runs on energy waves from the Nadesico!
In other words, if you leave the Nadesico and go out of energy range,
of course it's gonna stop moving!
Whaaat!? Tell me that kinda stuff sooner!
You lousy mechanic!
I went to the trouble of prepping an Aestivalis with a battery,
and you went off in the one without it! You lousy pilot!
(I'm done being locked up... I'm gonna be a cook.
I'm not dying in a place like this!)
More enemies incoming. ...Yamada's unit is completely surrounded now.
Is the engine ready yet!?
Three more minutes! ...Wait, can Yamada hold out!?
Akito!?
Can that cook even pilot!?
For some reason, he's had IFS treatment...
IFS?
IFS treatment... It stands for Image Feedback System.
Nanomachines form an auxiliary brain inside the body...
Um, Ruri, in simple terms... Besides, we're in the middle of a battle...
...It's a system that relays what you think directly to the machine.
Well, if he's had the treatment, he can manage an Aestivalis...
The rest comes down to talent.
Is he really gonna be okay... Yurika?
Yeah... Akito is my prince!
Whenever Yurika's in trouble, he always comes running!
Huh!? Hey, wait a sec, Yurika!
...But I can't use Akito as a decoy! It's too dangerous...!
Hey, what!? What decoy!?
I know! Your resolve is firm, Akito. A woman's whims can't change that!
Hey, hold on.
All right. The Nadesico and all of us...
and Yamada's life too... we leave them in your hands...
Please... come back alive...!
Hey, wait, Yurikaaa!
Gyaaaah! It's no good! I'm gonna die!
Huh!? Ngh... um... I've got no choice, do I!?
Aww, Akitooo! Take good care of our lives, and Yamada's tooo!
...Is this really okay?
Hmm, we can't move anyway.
Idiot...
More enemy reinforcements.
Launch preparations complete.
Akito... I won't let you die...!
Flooding about 80% complete. Opening gate.
Engine's good to go.
Nadesico, launch!
Nadesico... launching...!
Sorry to keep you waiting, Akito!
That was quick.
I hurried here just for you!
Enemy weapons are almost within effective range.
Target: all the enemies, every last one! Fiiire!!
A-Amazing...!
What is that battleship!?
And... what are these enemies? I've never seen this type before!?
Identification is... what's this? The Jovian Lizards!?
What? What are these Jovian Lizards?
Unidentified unmanned weapons that appeared on Mars months ago.
What, so you mean it's a new enemy?
Unknown. It may be a new force,
or it may be a new weapon of an existing enemy force.
Never mind that, right now...!
This is Kotaro Hazuki, Far East Commander and Gandor captain!
I'd like to speak with your captain.
What!? A huge... dragon!?
The Gandor...!
The ship that never gave an inch against the Muge Zorbados Empire...
Well... this is troublesome.
Whoa-ho! So that means in there is... the Super Beast Machine God!?
Got that right, it's common knowledge! ...Let's go!
Wait, Fujiwara!
Commander, we're surrounded by enemies. His call isn't wrong...
We're heading out too!
Agreed!
Hmph, not that the situation would matter to Fujiwara anyway.
Let's go, Hayato, Benkei!
Well, well, Dr. Hazuki... Oh, it's Commander now, isn't it?
Are you the captain of that ship?
Oh, heavens, no! I'm Prospector...
A Nergal Heavy Industries manager... really just an accountant.
The captain is this person here.
That's riiight!
Hello, everyooone! I'm the captaaain!
...V for victory!
V-V for victory...?
Ooh, nice energy.
Hold on, Masato.
Hey, knock it off already! We're asking you seriously here!
Um... they seem really suspicious of you.
Whaaat!? Boo!
...Hold on. I don't think we should doubt them right off the bat.
This hardly seems like a situation for jokes.
Wow, so cool.
(...Not reading the room... I'm used to that, thanks to a certain someone.)
But, hey, is that girl really the captain?
You shouldn't judge people by their looks, Koji.
...That said...
Misumaru... Could you be related to Admiral Misumaru?
Indeed. The captain is the daughter of the Federation Third Fleet's admiral...
Admiral Koichiro Misumaru.
It's been a while, Dr. Hazuki. We met once before at Federation University!
I-Is that so?
I'm sorry, Captain Misumaru... but I don't remember you.
Of course you don't! I was just one of lots and lots of students.
Your paper, "Human Wildness and Harmony with the Universe,"
moved me sooo much!
Wildness and the universe... are they even related?
Who knows.
What're you doing!? We're in the middle of a fight, old man Hazuki!
Indeed. So that battleship is the Nadesico...?
Nadesico?
Oh, so you know of it.
I've heard rumors, at least. That Nergal was building a secret warship.
"Secret battleship" sounds rather misleading, doesn't it?
We have, in fact, come to an arrangement with the Federation.
But... with no contact with Jaburo, there's no way to confirm that.
I'm afraid you'll have to explain yourselves.
(Hmm... It seems the Commander knows... Hmm.)
But why is a private company like Nergal building battleships?
We have our own objectives.
And what are those objectives?
...This may be no time to discuss objectives.
Huh!?
What! Enemy reinforcements!?
From above...!?
Ho-hohoho, the ones in space were tough,
but I wonder how the ones on the ground will fare...
Enemy identification unknown.
Is that the main force of the insect types...?
Either way, it looks like a new force.
Yeah, just how many enemy forces are out there...?
Hey! Help me out already!
Yurika!
Oops, I forgot! This is no time for chitchat!
The Nadesico will move to intercept! We've gotta back up Akito!
What about me!?
Understood.
All right, everyone, attack! Wipe out the bug mechs and their main force!
(Whaaat are these puny little things?
...Oh, well, so long as they don't get in our way.)
More enemy reinforcements!?
Hold it, hold it, hold iiit!
Hyoho? What? A robot?
Ooh! Yet another super robot shows up?
Sniff... all to save me... Thanks... thanks, everyone...!
Nah, that's just a coincidence.
What the...?
Is that the Gaizok Gramps was talking about?
Tch! Talk about bad taste.
You two! Whatever they look like, they're the enemy! Get serious!
Wh-What a ruuude bunch! I won't forgive you now!
Send out the Mecha Boost Gabitans till they're sick of 'em!
What's that robot with the crescent moon?
This is Hazuki of the Gandor. You in the robot! State your unit and name!
Unit and name? What're you talking about?
The Gaizok are invading to conquer Earth,
and you're wasting time on stuff like that!? That's why grown-ups suck!
Geez, you two! Um, you're Hazuki, sir?
We're part of the Jin Family, and to protect Earth from the Gaizok,
with this Zambot 3, we, um...
Children...!? How many are aboard? And the Gaizok? What's going on?
(Now's the only chance, it seems.)
This ain't the time for all this yammering, Hazuki!
At least we know who the enemy is, don't we!?
Commander, we should move to intercept before the damage spreads.
Too many forces are converging on one spot.
Wow, so many robots! Okay, Akito, we're not gonna lose either!
Now, now, Captain. Since friendly reinforcements have arrived,
let's have the Nadesico withdraw from the battle here.
Is that all right?
Whaaat? But this is where Akito's and my lovey-dovey all-out attack begins!
Like hell it is!
Hoshino, Haruka, an emergency withdrawal, please.
Is that all right?
Hmmm, it's true I can't put Akito in danger... Okay!
Besides, the Gandor unit won't lose! We'll recover Akito, then withdraw!
Please wait a moment. There's a great deal I'd like to ask you...
I'm sorry, but we're under no obligation to answer that.
But...!
Recover Akito's Aestivalis! We'll leave this area at maximum speed!
Um, Yamada went out too, you know...
We'll pick him up while we're at it.
...Nice work, Yamada.
It's DAIGOJI!!
Well then, everyone, we'll leave the rest to youuu!
1. Destroy all enemies
2. All allies destroyed
So that's the Nadesico... What a nuisance.
They're gone... What was up with that girl?
Feels like they just stirred everything up.
No kidding. ...Hope this doesn't turn into something weird.
You okay with this, Commander?
Okay or not, they're gone. Nothing we can do about it, right?
I know, but still.
Never mind that! Isn't beating the Gaizok what comes first!?
This ain't the time to be lazing around!
Hm, ah, sorry. Jin, you and the others join the battle too.
Leave it to us.
We're counting on you.
Ho ho ho, it seems your little chat is over...
Looks like it waited for us. ...A courteous invader.
Heh, get ready! I'm gonna avenge my ancestors, and I mean it!
So there were robots like this on the ground, too.
Oh well, today is just playtime after all.
Hey, you jerk, you running away!? Fight fair and square!
Ho-hohohoho!
Not to worry. From now on, I'll kill you all slowly... very slowly.
What's with them? What a dangerous bunch...
Can't see what they're after. ...What?
We'll explain later! Right now...!
I see. That Zambot 3 seems to be a robot built to fight them.
That's right. Where are the rest of the enemies!?
The Gaizok, huh... Everyone, if any enemies remain, sweep them up!
So this is... the Gaizok...
No purpose at all... They exist only to kill...
Yeah, the hardest kind of enemy to face. ...You can't even talk to them.
Relax later! Keep scanning for enemies!
Looks like that's the last of them.
The Gaizok... Could they have come to Sasebo after the Nadesico...?
Hm. It's not out of the question.
Either way, it means we've got more trouble on our hands.
Whatever! Let's just get going already!
We gotta chase after that Nadesico thing too, right?
Come to think of it... what about these kids!?
Now that you mention it. ...Well, I doubt they're enemies at this point.
You guys... will you fight alongside us?
I'll confirm it. Wait a moment.
Um... Commander Hazuki, do you believe we're on your side now?
...I've just confirmed it. A man named Hyozaemon Kamikita...
Keiko Kamikita, would he be your grandfather?
Yes, that's right!
The signal was bad, so we couldn't get it directly,
but apparently word came from the Saotome Laboratory.
Either way, we can't do anything until we hear the whole story...
If it's from the Saotome Lab, we can trust it. That makes it easy.
What'll we do, Commander Hazuki?
For now, you'll travel with us in the Gandor unit. All right?
Guess we got no choice. Well, we're counting on ya!
Hm... But to think we must rely on the strength of children this young...
That was normal on the Argama. Judau, for example.
Don't we have to go after that Nadesico?
...It'd be impossible to catch up now.
(The Nadesico... Does Captain Bright know about it...?)
